changes.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports Amazon EC2 G7 instances in service-managed fleets
changes.detail: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports Amazon EC2 G7 instances in service-managed fleets. Deadline Cloud is a fully managed service that helps teams run compute-intensive workloads for visual effects, animation, product design, simulation, and gaming. G7 instances give customers more options to scale GPU capacity quickly. You can add G7 instances to your service-managed fleets in sizes from g7.2xlarge to g7.48xlarge, with On-Demand or Spot pricing on Linux or Windows workers. This lets you scale GPU rendering capacity to match your production schedule without managing your own render farm infrastruct

changes.title: API Gateway: Feature (November 18, 2026)
changes.detail: Model routers can route to Google API endpoints on different hosts A model router can now reference Google API backends on different hosts, for example the global aiplatform.googleapis.com endpoint and a regional endpoint such as us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com , and in different projects. Previously, every backend referenced by a router had to share one hostname. Every backend referenced by a router must use https . Creating an API config with a router that uses http for any of its backends now fails; existing deployed gateways aren't affected. For more information, see Configure model
